stories.title: Macron says Lebanon’s fight is ‘just’ amid escalating attacks by Israel
stories.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron stated that Lebanon's fight against threats to its security is justified, amid ongoing Israeli military operations in the country.

stories.title: UN expert says world has given Israel ‘licence to torture Palestinians’
stories.summary: UN Special Rapporteur Francesca Albanese accused Israel of systematically torturing Palestinians, stating that torture has effectively become state policy.

stories.title: Colombian military plane with 125 people crashes
stories.summary: A Colombian military plane carrying 125 people crashed in what Defense Minister described as a tragic accident, though the cause remains under investigation.

stories.title: Have Israel, the US and Iran violated international law?
stories.summary: A report examines whether Israel, the United States, and Iran have violated international law, noting that civilian targets have been struck by all three parties involved in the conflict.

stories.title: Smotrich urges Israel to annex southern Lebanon as assault intensifies
stories.summary: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called for Israel to annex southern Lebanon up to the Litani River as Israeli military operations in Lebanon intensify.

stories.title: Iranian officials dismiss claims of US talks
stories.summary: Senior Iranian officials denied reports that Iran has held talks with the United States.

stories.title: Oil falls and shares rebound after Trump says talks have been held to end war
stories.summary: Global oil prices fell and stock markets rebounded after US President Donald Trump announced that productive talks have been held to end the ongoing war.

stories.title: A committed pharmacist and a homesick blogger – the Iranian civilians killed in the war
stories.summary: Iranian civilians, including a pharmacist and a blogger, have been killed as the US-Israeli military campaign against Iran continues, with civilian casualties mounting.

stories.title: Ex-teacher accused of Scotland school abuse found guilty of sex attack in South Africa
stories.summary: Former teacher Iain Wares was found guilty in a Cape Town court of indecently assaulting a former student, related to accusations of sexual abuse at a Scottish school in the 1980s.

stories.title: US' and Iran's options for ending war narrow the longer it goes on
stories.summary: Analysis suggests that options for ending the US-Iran conflict are narrowing as the war continues, with Iran showing no signs of backing down and US air power alone unable to achieve its objectives.

stories.title: Blast that injured two was 'terrorist attack', Ukrainian authorities say
stories.summary: Ukrainian authorities classified a blast that injured two people as a terrorist attack, with a 21-year-old local suspect claiming he was blackmailed into planting the explosives.

stories.title: Australia's ABC staff to go on strike for first time in 20 years
stories.summary: Staff at Australia's national broadcaster ABC announced a 24-hour strike, the first in 20 years, which is expected to disrupt live television and radio programming.

stories.title: Germany has a shortage of workers - so it's turning to India for help
stories.summary: Germany is recruiting skilled workers from India to address a significant labor shortage in the country.

stories.title: France's Socialists hold on to power in major cities in election boost for mainstream
stories.summary: France's Socialist Party retained control of Paris and Marseille in local elections, while the nationalist right won in Nice and several other towns.

stories.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
stories.summary: Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villages and properties in the occupied West Bank following the death of 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman, who was reportedly struck by a Palestinian-driven vehicle while on a quad bike.

stories.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
stories.summary: Cuba experienced a second complete power grid failure within a week, highlighting the country's ongoing energy crisis amid a US-imposed fuel blockade.

stories.title: Israel to expand ground and air attacks against Hezbollah in Lebanon
stories.summary: Israel has announced plans to expand its ground and air military operations against Hezbollah in Lebanon, raising concerns about a potential large-scale ground invasion.

stories.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
stories.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles struck towns near an Israeli nuclear facility, injuring 180 people and prompting an Israeli investigation into how the missiles penetrated the country's air defense systems.

stories.title: Sudan drone attack on key hospital killed 64 people during Eid, WHO says
stories.summary: A drone attack on a hospital in Sudan during Eid killed 64 people, including 13 children, two nurses, and a doctor, according to the World Health Organization.

stories.title: Car stolen with two-month-old baby inside
stories.summary: A car was stolen with a two-month-old baby inside, but police quickly rescued the infant unharmed and returned him to his mother.

stories.title: Venezuelan leader replaces senior military commanders
stories.summary: Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro replaced senior military commanders following the appointment of a new defense minister by Vice President Delcy Rodríguez, a move that human rights organizations criticized as perpetuating impunity.
